item.title: Good Morning Family - 14 September 2026
item.description:
Wakey Wakey breakfast crew!
Hello everyone!
Today is Monday, the 14 September.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 12 degrees and a top of 18 degrees.
There is about a 69 percent chance of rain.
You might need a raincoat today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is W.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter W?
. . . . . . . . . . . . .
